summary: Completed frontend testing of Variable Pay feature for Kora OS. All features working correctly: navigation to People Ops, Variable Pay tab, list view with existing runs, create dialog, run detail view, and full approval workflow (Draft -> Pending -> Approved -> Completed). Config section shows Variable Pay configuration with payment dates per type.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Dialog component should have aria-describedby for accessibility compliance

context_for_next_testing_agent: Variable Pay feature fully functional. Two existing runs tested: 'Horas Extras - Test' (Completed with 1 employee, $6,909.73 net) and 'Horas Extras Marzo 2026' (now Completed after testing full workflow). Config section has Variable Pay configuration for Overtime (Day 7), Commissions (Day 15), Bonuses/Incentives (Day 5), and Benefits (with payroll). The completed run tested has 0 entries because no approved overtime exists for that period.
